Hi @pcbeingused333, thanks for your interest in contributing to Haystack! :pray:

:warning: You currently have 3 open pull requests in this repository (#3926, #3873 and this one). Our review capacity is limited, so please hold off opening more PRs until we've had a chance to review your first 2 open PRs. This helps us give each contribution the attention it deserves. Thank you!

_This is an automated message to help us keep the review queue healthy._

**Heads-up for maintainers**

This PR is from a fork and touches integrations whose integration tests require API keys.
Those tests are **skipped** in CI because fork PRs don't have access to repo secrets for security reasons.

Affected integrations:
- transformers

Please run the integration tests locally (`hatch run test:integration` inside each folder) before approving.
<!-- Sticky Pull Request Commentfork-pr-api-keys -->
## Coverage report (transformers) _This PR does not seem to contain any modification to coverable code._

Closing as a duplicate of #3873, which already fixes this exact case (`TransformersExtractiveReader.overlap_threshold`) along with `S3Downloader.boto3_config`, with the same round-trip test approach. #3873 has been open since 31 Aug; I missed it when filing this. Sorry for the noise.
